method.request: First appearance of a distinct (chain, assistant message.id); stream blocks do not add requests
method.formula: command generation once + command/context-result token count times subsequent observed in-chain requests retaining the original fragment
method.compaction: Keep only explicit preserved_messages.all_uuids / preservedMessages.allUuids; no attribution of summary text to old Bash categories

scenarios.preserved_messages: Observed compactions, including retained original messages
scenarios.reset_at_compaction: Sensitivity: discard all old Bash text at each compaction
scenarios.ignore_compaction: Naive comparator: keep original text until chain ends

method.optional_compaction_input: Additional one pass over pre-compaction Bash context per boundary; hypothesis, not an observed model request; excluded from primary total
method.between_boundaries_assumption: Observed fragments remain intact until the next logged compaction unless their chain ends; unlogged context edits cannot be reconstructed
method.child_chains: Separate parent_tool_use_id chains; only locally observed content is replayed; unknown inherited parent context excluded
excluded: Initial/system prompt, thinking, prose, non-Bash tools and schema overhead
Hidden requests, retries without distinct response ID, summary generation
TaskOutput/non-Bash reads not back-attributed to Bash
not_inferred: Unlogged context truncation, clearing or replacement
Per-fragment cache hit status or input/cache-read/cache-write split
Counterfactual savings from removing an action
